_comment: T14.52: the words of the question when a call seems to have ended, with stopping by itself on (will_stop) and off (asks_only). The notification (Rust's shell.rs) and the meeting screen's banner and compact card (the UI's meeting/MeetingViews.tsx, which reads this file) say them; both suites check against this table, so a copy change edits it.
notification_title: The call seems to have ended
banner_title: The call seems to have ended.
will_stop: Earshot will stop recording within 3 minutes unless you keep it going.
asks_only: Do you want to stop recording? Earshot keeps recording until you stop it.
compact_will_stop: The call seems to have ended. Stopping within 3 minutes.
compact_asks_only: The call seems to have ended.
